_about: Public-domain Adolf (von) Harnack (1851-1930, Berlin church historian) in English for the Word Hoard: 16 volumes from Internet Archive scans, among them What is Christianity? (1901), The Expansion of Christianity (2 vols, 1904-1905), the New Testament Studies (Luke the Physician, The Sayings of Jesus, The Acts, The Date of the Acts, 1907-1911), Constitution and Law of the Church (1910), the Outlines of the History of Dogma (1893) and Essays on the Social Gospel with Wilhelm Herrmann (1907). His History of Dogma (Buchanan's translation) is on the neil-buchanan shelf, not here. Added 2026-10-18 by lane A, round 29 (my pick); Adam may veto the whole shelf. Every printing dated before 1930, so public domain in the US. No uids minted.
